$comment: The desktop performance budget's ceilings on Linux, for pnpm bench:linux, measured in the ngn-el9 image under Xvfb with GSK_RENDERER=cairo at CI runner class (4 vCPU, 16 GB). Provisional, from the Linux spec's section 12: the first stable median plus 20 to 30% replaces each. A cairo number is never compared with another renderer's. A waiver is { metric, reason, pr }.
